title: The Invoices import template keeps every other column and the column order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a copy of the Invoices import template downloaded before this release, the old template, so its headers can be compared.
  • Use Google Sheets (File, then Import, then Upload) to open downloaded files, so accented letters and character counts read correctly.
  • Start on Settings, then Invoices under Data Import in the Settings left menu.
custom_steps:
1. Click Download template.
  2. Open the downloaded template in Google Sheets.
  3. Open the old template in Google Sheets.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A template file downloads.

Step 2:

  • Its header row has 24 columns; column 16 reads "*Line Title" and column 17 reads "Line Description".

Step 3:

  • The old template's header row also has 24 columns.
  • Column by column, every header has the same name in the same position in both files, except two: column 16 ("*Line Title", was "*Line Title - What are you doing") and column 17 ("Line Description", was "Line Description - Why are you doing it").

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10133 (Story 4, The Imports)

  • S4-R7: “Every other column name, and the required order of columns, is unchanged.”
  • S4-R2: “The historical invoice import's two columns (Administration → Invoices) are named "*Line Title" and "Line Description", replacing "*Line Title - What are you doing" and "Line Description - Why are you doing it".”
  • Assumptions: “Import templates are kept and reused by shops for years, so header stability matters more than tidiness.”

From: Tech plan "Title and Description — Technical Implementation Plan" (23 Sep 2026; re-shared by the QA lead on 27 Oct 2026, unchanged), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, Phase 4: “Only those two tokens change; the other 22 columns and the order stay byte-identical”
  • Tech plan, D4: “In WorkOrderHistorical/ImportCommandHandler, REQUIRED_HEADERS slots 15/16 become '*Line Title' / 'Line Description'”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
